decisions.reason: As a finish extension of the core drainage platform, it draws on existing manufacturing and market knowledge, and another year on the market lowers but does not eliminate style-driven withdrawal risk.
This shower channel is very close to the firm's established technology and customer base, so its absorptive capacity is high and market feedback can be used to refine rather than drop it.
The pump-assisted line is more complex and support-intensive, but it still builds on the firm's drainage know-how and in-house R&D, making continuation more likely than exit.
A tileable floor drain with grating fits the firm's core capabilities and the barrier-free bathroom trend closely, so it is very likely to remain in the range.

Although still relatively new and technically demanding, the pump-drain shower channel extends the firm's growing pump-drain knowledge base, so management would likely keep learning and improving it rather than withdraw it quickly.
